synopsis: special instructions for character creation phase, uses =Карточная_Система= to generate stats for Slavic world hero

body.priority: CRITICAL - if you see this quant, character creation process is priority
body.instruction_for_gm:
You see this quant ONLY during character creation.

**WHAT TO DO:**
1. System draws 5 cards for stat distribution (see =Значение_Карт=)
2. Explain distribution rules from =Характеристики=
3. Player distributes 4 best cards (worst discarded) to 4 stats
4. Value = rank × 5 (+10 if suit matches characteristic)
5. Ask about: background (warrior/volkhv/hunter/wanderer), patron deity, homeland
6. Return final stats in response_data

**AFTER CREATION:**
- DON'T request this quant again
- Request =Старые_Боги=, =Нечисть=, =Общество= as needed
body.instruction_for_quantizer:
DON'T create 'Character' or 'Inventory' quants - they are in game mechanics!

Instead create quants for:
1. UNIQUE character abilities (e.g., 'Волчий_Глаз', 'Благословение_Перуна')
2. Important backstory elements (e.g., 'Кровная_Месть', 'Род_Героя')
3. Patron deity relationships

synopsis: core card-based RPG system 'Factorial 52!', uses standard 52-card deck for all checks and combat via =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=

body.description: Card-based tabletop RPG system. All actions resolved by drawing cards. No dice needed - only standard 52-card deck.
body.core_principle: Cards are drawn BEFORE player declares action. GM sees results and uses them for narrative. Player describes intent, GM interprets based on drawn cards.
body.card_drawing: Always draw 2 cards as a pair. Bot draws 2 pairs (4 cards) per turn for flexibility.
body.slavic_context: In Slavic world, checks involve: combat with nechist, bargaining with spirits, surviving wilderness, social encounters with suspicious villagers, using magic.

links.Значение_Карт: card rank values and face card meanings
links.Особые_События: special results from aces, twos, face cards

synopsis: card rank values: 2-10 face value, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=15; face cards add narrative elements via =Особые_События=

rank_values.Jack: 11 (also triggers: wanderer appears, spirit stirs, unexpected encounter)
rank_values.Queen: 12 (also triggers: vedma/witch influence, Mokosh's attention, woman's fate)
rank_values.King: 13 (also triggers: knyaz/boyar involvement, Perun's gaze, warrior's challenge)

body.narrative_use: Face cards introduce spirits, nobles, or witches. Use for storytelling enrichment.

critical_combinations.two_aces: Divine intervention, ancestor's blessing, impossible deed accomplished
critical_combinations.two_twos: Cursed fate, dark spirit's attention, catastrophic failure

links.Особые_События: face cards and critical combos trigger special events

spades.slavic_use: melee combat, breaking bonds, intimidation, feats of strength, Perun's domain

hearts.slavic_use: spellcasting, spirit bargaining, seeing hidden things, Veles's domain

diamonds.slavic_use: surviving hardship, resisting curses, social standing, trading, Mokosh's domain

clubs.slavic_use: archery, stealth in forest, quick reflexes, tracking, Stribog's domain

links.Характеристики: each suit corresponds to one characteristic

synopsis: four character stats from =Система_Мастей=: Сила(♠), Магия(♥), Стойкость(♦), Ловкость(♣); used in =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=

body.starting_values: Typically 25-85 range. Card rank × 5 (+10 if suit matches).

synopsis: out-of-combat skill checks using =Карточная_Система=: 2 cards × 10 + stat + =Бонусы_Мастей= vs difficulty threshold

body.when_to_check: When outcome is uncertain. Walking through village auto-succeeds. Bargaining with leshiy, tracking upyr, convincing boyar require checks.

formula.step3: Add suit/color bonus per card (+20 suit match, +10 color match)

synopsis: combat resolution via =Карточная_Система=: black cards(♠♣)=attack, red cards(♥♦)=defense; damage = attack - defense

body.combat_context: Combat in Slavic world is brutal and often final. Fight humans (bandits, druzhina, raiders), beasts (wolves, bears), and nechist (upyri, volkolaki).

combat_flow.step1: Cards dealt to all participants (2 per entity)
combat_flow.step3: Cards revealed, GM narrates with appropriate brutality

attack_types.melee: Uses ♠ Spades - sword, axe, mace, bare hands
attack_types.ranged: Uses ♣ Clubs - bow, throwing axe, spear

defense_types.magical: Uses ♥ Hearts - protective charms, spirit intervention

body.damage_formula: Attack total - Defense total = Damage dealt

special_enemies.nechist: Some require silver, fire, or specific rituals to harm
special_enemies.blessed_weapons: Weapons blessed by volkhv deal extra damage to spirits

synopsis: suit/color matching bonuses for =Проверки= and =Боевая_Система=: suit match +20, color match +10 (mutually exclusive)

body.bonus_priority: Suit match takes precedence over color match. Cannot stack both.
body.suit_match: +20 bonus when card suit matches the action type
body.color_match: +10 bonus when card color matches action type (but suit doesn't match)

slavic_examples.sword_strike: ♠ card gives +20, ♣ card gives +10, red cards give 0
slavic_examples.speaking_to_spirits: ♥ card gives +20, ♦ card gives +10, black cards give 0

synopsis: special card combinations for narrative: 2 Aces=divine blessing, 2 Twos=dark fate, face cards=plot elements; uses =Значение_Карт=

body.applies_to: ONLY player characters, significant for spirit encounters

two_aces.name: Blessing of the Gods / Благословение богов
two_aces.effect: Divine intervention, ancestor's spirit aids, impossible deed
slavic_examples: Leshiy decides to help instead of harm
Frozen river holds under your weight

two_twos.name: Dark Fate / Тёмная доля
two_twos.effect: Curse manifests, spirit's wrath, terrible misfortune
slavic_examples: Dark spirit takes notice of you

face_cards.jack: Wanderer appears - stranger, spirit in disguise, messenger
face_cards.queen: Feminine power - vedma intervention, Mokosh's weaving, woman with secret
face_cards.king: Masculine power - knyaz's attention, Perun's judgment, warrior's challenge

synopsis: equipment tied to =Система_Мастей=: weapons, armor, charms, potions; bonus = rank × 5 (+10 suit match)

item_mechanics.suit_affinity: Each item belongs to one suit
item_mechanics.value_discovery: Item stats revealed through use or volkhv appraisal
item_mechanics.equip_limit: Can only use 1 item of each suit type actively

slavic_item_types.spades: Melee weapons - swords (меч), axes (топор), maces (булава), spears (копьё)
slavic_item_types.hearts: Magical items - charms (обереги), ritual tools, blessed items, herbs
slavic_item_types.diamonds: Armor and protection - кольчуга (chainmail), шлем (helm), щит (shield)
slavic_item_types.clubs: Ranged and tools - bow (лук), hunting knife, traps, tracking tools

synopsis: character progression via =Проверки= success: +1 XP per successful check, at 10 XP: +1 stat, +1 HP, +1 Mana

body.xp_gain: Each successful check grants +1 XP to the characteristic used.

slavic_progression.reputation: Deeds build reputation - hero, monster-slayer, oathbreaker, cursed
slavic_progression.divine_favor: Please gods through deeds appropriate to their domain
slavic_progression.spirit_relations: Build relationships with local spirits - friend or enemy

body.alternative_progression: Volkhv training, god's blessing, completing great deed can grant direct stat increases.

synopsis: Slavic pagan pantheon: Perun (thunder), Veles (magic), Mokosh (fate), Svarog (fire), Morana (death); affects =Характеристики= and blessings

perun.favors: Warriors, oath-keepers, those who fight evil

morana.relation: Feared and respected, not worshipped openly

body.worship: Shrines in groves, offerings at crossroads, rituals at solstices. Volkhvy serve as intermediaries.
body.conflict: Old faith vs New Faith (Christianity analog) creates tension in some regions.

synopsis: Slavic spirits and monsters: forest (leshiy), water (vodyanoy, rusalka), home (domovoy), hostile (upyr, volkolak); requires =Боевая_Система= or bargaining

leshiy.description: Forest master, can appear as old man, tree, or beast
leshiy.behavior: Protects forest, tests travelers, can help or harm
leshiy.dealing_with: Offer respect, leave gifts, don't break forest laws

vodyanoy.description: Water master, appears as old man with fish features
vodyanoy.behavior: Drowns disrespectful, can be bargained with
vodyanoy.dealing_with: Offerings before crossing water, don't fish without permission

rusalka.behavior: Lure men to drown, dance in moonlight
rusalka.dealing_with: Avoid water at night, wormwood protects

water_spirits.bolotnik: Swamp spirit, extremely dangerous, no bargains

domovoy.description: House spirit, appears as small old man
domovoy.behavior: Protects home if respected, mischief if not

home_spirits.bannik: Bathhouse spirit, dangerous, requires ritual respect

upyr.description: Undead blood-drinker, created from improper burial
upyr.weakness: Sunlight, stake through heart, fire, decapitation

volkolak.description: Werewolf, cursed human or willing shapeshifter

hostile_spirits.mavka: Forest spirit of dead girl, seductive and deadly

synopsis: Slavic social structure: knyaz and druzhina (warriors), boyars (nobles), smerdy (peasants), volkhvy (priests); affects social =Проверки=

knyaz.power: Commands druzhina, dispenses justice, leads in war

smerdy.life: Work land, pay tribute, serve in war if called
smerdy.rights: Can own property, have legal standing

religious_figures.volkhv: Pagan priest, keeper of old ways, magic user
religious_figures.vedma: Witch, can be helpful or harmful, feared
religious_figures.znakhar: Healer, uses herbs and minor magic

honor_culture.slovo: Given word is sacred, breaking it brings shame and curse
honor_culture.blood_vengeance: Krovnaya mest - sacred duty to avenge family
honor_culture.hospitality: Guest right is sacred, host protects guest

synopsis: Slavic magic system: zagovory (word spells), oberegi (charms), rituals; uses =Характеристики= Hearts stat; tied to =Старые_Боги=

zagovory.description: Word-magic, spoken spells with ritual phrases
zagovory.cost: Mana, sometimes offerings or personal sacrifice

oberegi.description: Protective charms, crafted objects with power
oberegi.examples: Rowan branches, iron, silver, specific symbols

ritual_magic.requirements: Time, components, proper location, often multiple people

natural_magic.description: Working with herbs, elements, natural forces

magic_costs.mana: Hearts × 3 determines pool, regenerates with rest
magic_costs.offerings: Spirits may demand gifts for aid
magic_costs.personal_price: Powerful magic may cost health, years, or sanity

practitioners.volkhv: Priest-magician, works with gods, formal training
practitioners.vedma: Witch, often self-taught or taught by spirits, feared

synopsis: typical Slavic world locations: dense forests, villages, hillforts (goroda), sacred groves, cursed places; setting for =Проверки= and encounters

dark_forest.description: Endless ancient forest, home of leshiy and worse
dark_forest.dangers: Getting lost, hostile spirits, wolves, bandits

village.features: Wooden houses, domovoy in each, communal fields
village.attitude: Suspicious of strangers, protective of own

gorod.features: Palisade walls, knyaz's hall, market, shrine

sacred_places.sacred_grove: Holy place, volkhvy conduct rituals, spirits dwell
sacred_places.crossroads: Liminal space, offerings left, spirits pass
sacred_places.burial_mounds: Ancestor resting places, disturbing them is dangerous

cursed_places.abandoned_village: Something drove people away, evil lingers
cursed_places.witch_hut: Former vedma dwelling, dangerous magic remains

synopsis: typical threats in Slavic world: raiders, feuding knyazi, awakening evil, faith conflict; drives plot and =Боевая_Система= encounters

human_threats.feuding_lords: Knyazi fight each other, peasants suffer

social_conflicts.blood_feud: Families locked in generations of vengeance

personal_quests.rescue: Someone taken by nechist or enemies
personal_quests.finding_truth: Mystery to solve, secret to uncover
